not_error_code.description: HTTP/status codes that should be treated as warnings instead of failures.

status.description: Expected final status for this tool call. Use fail for negative probes such as denied writes.

requiredFields.description: Field names that must appear anywhere in the tool result payload.

maxRows.description: Maximum allowed row count. Uses rowCount, rowsReturned, or common rows/data/items arrays.

errorCode.description: Stable error code expected in an error response.

contains.description: Text snippets that must appear in the result or error payload.

notContains.description: Text snippets that must not appear in the result or error payload. Use this to catch leaked internals.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema subset applied to the observed tool result payload. Supported keywords include type, required, properties, items, enum, additionalProperties, minimum, maximum, minLength, maxLength, and pattern.
